title: Confidence Composition for Multiagent Language Model Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.13591v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiagent language model systems, such as collaborative reasoning and debate, produce multiple correlated candidate answers and confidence signals. However, these signals are usually calibrated only at the individual agent level, and provide no principled confidence estimate for the system's final answer. We formulate this as a confidence composition problem where combining confidence across agents and reasoning stages while preserving both selective utility and probabilistic reliability. We study confidence-aware routing and log-odds pooling protocols that select among candidate answers and output a system-level confidence. Across five benchmarks, 30 heterogeneous and homogeneous model pairs, and two confidence estimators, our gated-fusion methods improve AUARC and reduce Brier score over single agent, standard debate, and selective debate baselines, while retaining competitive weighted F1-score as a correctness metric. translated_title: 多智能体语言模型系统的置信度组合
translated_abstract: 多智能体语言模型系统（如协作推理和辩论）会产生多个相关的候选答案和置信度信号。然而，这些信号通常仅在单个智能体层面进行校准，无法为系统的最终答案提供有原则的置信度估计。我们将此问题表述为一个置信度组合问题，即在跨智能体和推理阶段组合置信度的同时，既保持选择性效用又保持概率可靠性。我们研究了置信度感知路由和对数几率池化协议，用于在候选答案中进行选择并输出系统级置信度。在五个基准测试、30对异构和同构模型对以及两种置信度估计器上，我们的门控融合方法相比单智能体、标准辩论和选择性辩论基线，提高了AUARC并降低了Brier分数，同时作为正确性指标保持了有竞争力的加权F1分数。
tldr: 该论文将多智能体语言模型系统的置信度组合形式化为一个新问题，提出基于置信度感知路由和对数几率池化的门控融合方法来生成系统级置信度估计，在五个基准上相比单智能体和辩论基线同时提升了选择性效用（AUARC）与概率可靠性（Brier分数）。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes confidence composition for multiagent language model systems, proposing gated-fusion methods with confidence-aware routing and log-odds pooling that output system-level confidence, improving AUARC and reducing Brier score over single-agent and debate baselines across five benchmarks.
